name: Nonohara Rena
source: An introverted girl with low self-esteem who can't make friends due to her insecurities. She hates this about herself, but can't seem to do anything about it. She's unremarkably average at both studies and physical activity. She has a weak spirit and gets overlooked often. A bit of a scaredy-cat, too.
